title: HSK 3.18 · 农民, 民族, 自主, 身份证
focus: 石油 · 情感 · 称为 · 计算 · 始终 · 订 · 各地 · 把握 · 课程 · 石头 · 各自 · 自身 · 感冒 · 农民 · 民族 · 预计 · 邮件 · 身份证 · 头脑 · 亲人 · 初步 · 预防 · 手续 · 工程师 · 人工 · 证件 · 中华民族 · 农业 · 加工 · 中部 · 主张 · 亲切 · 自主 · 握手 · 民间 · 初中 · 卫生间 · 动人 · 生动 · 自觉
body:
People, self and paperwork: 民 "the people" anchors 农民, 民族 and 民间, 自 "self" builds four words, and 证 "proof" gives you the ID-card words you meet at every counter.

## Characters that repeat

| Character | Pinyin | Meaning | In this lesson |
|---|---|---|---|
| 自 | zì | self (drawing of a nose) | 各自, 自身, 自主, 自觉 |
| 民 | mín | the people | 农民, 民族, 中华民族, 民间 |
| 工 | gōng | work | 工程师, 人工, 加工 |
| 农 | nóng | farming | 农民, 农业 |
| 初 | chū | beginning (衤 cloth + 刀 knife) | 初步, 初中 |
| 预 | yù | in advance | 预计, 预防 |
| 证 | zhèng | proof, certificate (讠 + 正) | 身份证, 证件 |
| 亲 | qīn | close, related by blood | 亲人, 亲切 |

## Watch out

- 初 has 衤 clothing on the left, not 礻.
- 石头 and 卫生间 end in light syllables: shítou, wèishēngjiān.

cards.Example: 石油又涨价了。 shíyóu yòu zhǎngjià le: oil prices went up again
cards.Notes: 石 stone + 油 oil (氵 liquid + 由 yóu phonetic) = rock oil, petroleum

cards.Example: 他很少表达情感。 tā hěn shǎo biǎodá qínggǎn: he rarely shows emotion
cards.Notes: 情 feeling (忄 heart + 青 qīng phonetic) + 感 feel (心 heart + 咸 phonetic) = emotion

cards.Example: 北京被称为首都。 Běijīng bèi chēngwéi shǒudū: Beijing is called the capital
cards.Notes: 称 call, name + 为 wéi as = call (something) as

cards.Example: 你计算一下。 nǐ jìsuàn yíxià: work it out
cards.Notes: 计 count (讠 speech + 十 ten) + 算 calculate (竹 bamboo counting rods on top) = compute

cards.Meaning: all along, from start to finish
cards.Example: 他始终没说话。 tā shǐzhōng méi shuōhuà: he never said a word the whole time
cards.Notes: 始 begin + 终 end = from beginning to end, throughout

cards.Meaning: to book, order; to draw up
cards.Example: 我订了两张票。 wǒ dìng le liǎng zhāng piào: I booked two tickets
cards.Notes: 订 = 讠 speech + 丁 dīng for the sound: agree on in words, so book; lookalike 钉 nail (金)

cards.Example: 人们从各地来。 rénmen cóng gèdì lái: people come from all over
cards.Notes: 各 each + 地 place = every place

cards.Example: 我没有把握。 wǒ méiyǒu bǎwò: I'm not sure I can
cards.Notes: 把 hold + 握 grip (扌 hand + 屋 phonetic) = a firm grip, so certainty

cards.Example: 这门课程很难。 zhè mén kèchéng hěn nán: this course is hard
cards.Notes: 课 lesson + 程 procedure, schedule = a program of lessons

cards.Example: 这块石头很重。 zhè kuài shítou hěn zhòng: this rock is heavy
cards.Notes: 石 stone (a rock under a cliff 厂) + 头 noun suffix, neutral tone

cards.Example: 我们各自回家。 wǒmen gèzì huí jiā: we each went home
cards.Notes: 各 each + 自 self = each on their own

cards.Example: 先看看自身的问题。 xiān kànkan zìshēn de wèntí: look at your own problems first
cards.Notes: 自 self + 身 body = one's own self

cards.Meaning: to catch a cold; a cold
cards.Example: 我感冒了。 wǒ gǎnmào le: I've caught a cold
cards.Notes: 感 be affected + 冒 run into, risk (as in 冒险) = catch a cold

cards.Example: 他爸爸是农民。 tā bàba shì nóngmín: his dad is a farmer
cards.Notes: 农 farming + 民 people = farming people

cards.Example: 中国有很多民族。 Zhōngguó yǒu hěn duō mínzú: China has many ethnic groups
cards.Notes: 民 people + 族 clan, group = a people, ethnic group

cards.Example: 预计明天到。 yùjì míngtiān dào: expected to arrive tomorrow
cards.Notes: 预 in advance + 计 count = calculate ahead, forecast

cards.Example: 我给你发邮件。 wǒ gěi nǐ fā yóujiàn: I'll email you
cards.Notes: 邮 mail, post + 件 item = a piece of mail (now usually email)

cards.Example: 请出示身份证。 qǐng chūshì shēnfènzhèng: please show your ID
cards.Notes: 身份 identity (身 body + 份 share, status) + 证 certificate = identity certificate

cards.Example: 他很有头脑。 tā hěn yǒu tóunǎo: he's very smart
cards.Notes: 头 head + 脑 brain (月 body + phonetic) = brains, a good head

cards.Example: 他是我的亲人。 tā shì wǒ de qīnrén: he's family to me
cards.Notes: 亲 close, related by blood + 人 person = loved ones, kin

cards.Example: 这只是初步计划。 zhè zhǐ shì chūbù jìhuà: this is just a first plan
cards.Notes: 初 beginning + 步 step = first step

cards.Example: 多洗手，预防感冒。 duō xǐ shǒu, yùfáng gǎnmào: wash hands to prevent colds
cards.Notes: 预 in advance + 防 guard (阝 + 方 fāng phonetic) = guard ahead of time

cards.Example: 手续很麻烦。 shǒuxù hěn máfan: the paperwork is a hassle
cards.Notes: 手 hand + 续 continue, follow on (纟 thread) = step-by-step procedures

cards.Example: 我哥哥是工程师。 wǒ gēge shì gōngchéngshī: my brother is an engineer
cards.Notes: 工程 project (工 work + 程 procedure) + 师 master, expert = engineer

cards.Example: 这是人工湖。 zhè shì réngōng hú: this is a man-made lake
cards.Notes: 人 human + 工 work = man-made, manual

cards.Example: 带好你的证件。 dài hǎo nǐ de zhèngjiàn: bring your ID
cards.Notes: 证 proof + 件 item = identification papers

cards.Example: 中华民族历史很长。 Zhōnghuá mínzú lìshǐ hěn cháng: the Chinese nation has a long history
cards.Notes: 中华 China (中 middle + 华 splendid) + 民族 nation

cards.Example: 这里以农业为主。 zhèlǐ yǐ nóngyè wéi zhǔ: this area is mainly farming
cards.Notes: 农 farming + 业 industry, trade = agriculture

cards.Example: 这是加工食品。 zhè shì jiāgōng shípǐn: this is processed food
cards.Notes: 加 add + 工 work = add work to raw material, process

cards.Example: 他住在中部。 tā zhù zài zhōngbù: he lives in the central region
cards.Notes: 中 middle + 部 part = central region

cards.Example: 我主张早点走。 wǒ zhǔzhāng zǎo diǎn zǒu: I'm for leaving early
cards.Notes: 主 main, master + 张 stretch out, spread = the view one puts forward

cards.Example: 老师很亲切。 lǎoshī hěn qīnqiè: the teacher is very warm
cards.Notes: 亲 close + 切 qiè close, intimate (not qiē 'cut' here) = warm and friendly

cards.Example: 孩子要学会自主。 háizi yào xuéhuì zìzhǔ: kids must learn independence
cards.Notes: 自 self + 主 master = be your own master

cards.Example: 我们握握手吧。 wǒmen wòwo shǒu ba: let's shake hands
cards.Notes: 握 grip (扌 hand + 屋 wū phonetic) + 手 hand = grip hands

cards.Example: 这是民间故事。 zhè shì mínjiān gùshi: this is a folk tale
cards.Notes: 民 people + 间 among, between = among ordinary people

cards.Example: 我妹妹上初中。 wǒ mèimei shàng chūzhōng: my sister is in junior high
cards.Notes: 初(级) junior + 中(学) middle school = junior middle school

cards.Example: 卫生间在哪儿？ wèishēngjiān zài nǎr: where's the bathroom?
cards.Notes: 卫生 hygiene (卫 guard + 生 life) + 间 room = hygiene room, restroom

cards.Example: 这首歌很动人。 zhè shǒu gē hěn dòngrén: this song is moving
cards.Notes: 动 move + 人 people = moves people

cards.Example: 他讲得很生动。 tā jiǎng de hěn shēngdòng: he tells it vividly
cards.Notes: 生 alive + 动 moving = lively, vivid

cards.Example: 他学习很自觉。 tā xuéxí hěn zìjué: he studies without being told
cards.Notes: 自 self + 觉 aware, sense = self-aware, self-motivated
